$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFSJ (AIP France, chart dated 2023-10-05): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Sedan - Douzy

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: During rainy period, pilots are restricted to use the paved RWY only and the East paved TWY.
Variation in level between paved RWY and grass strip 08/26.
Taxiing on this part of AD is prohibited.
Radio use highly recommended.
Preferred QFU: 076°, due to clearing.
Avoid overflying the surrounding built up areas.
Simultaneous use of both RWY prohibited.
Paved TWY reserved for ACFT whose overall length of the main landing gear is less than 3.5 m and whose wingspan is less than 11 m.
Precautionary taxiing recommended on the paved TWY due to the presence of a fence in the TWY strip.
Gliders winching (NR 956): SR-SS, SFC-2200 ft AMSL.
Winch equipped with a flashing light.
Users information on A/A SEDAN.
Aerobatics on AD (NR 6100): North and parallel to grass strip 08/26, East limit road D 964, length 3000 m, width 500 m.1650 ft AAL/5000 ft AAL.
SAT, SUN and HOL: SR-SS.
AEM (NR 8228): 500 ft ASFC (600 ft ASFC announced via NOTAM), SR-SS.
En période de pluie, n'utiliser que la piste macadam et le TWY Est en tarmac.
Existence d'une dénivellation entre la piste revêtue et la piste non revêtue 08/26.
Le roulage sur cette zone est interdit.
Utilisation de la radio vivement recommandée.
QFU 076° préférentiel cause dégagements.
Éviter le survol des zones habitées avoisinantes.
Usage simultané des deux pistes interdit.
Voie de circulation revêtue réservée aux aéronefs dont la longueur hors tout du train principal est inférieure à 3,5 m et dont l'envergure est inférieure à 11 m.

Information des usagers sur A/A SEDAN.
